build_task_template: build a PHyRE task template with two balls that must touch rather than fall in jars
add_dynamic_ball: create dynamic ball objects positioned at specific x and y coordinates in the scene
add_dynamic_jar: add dynamic jar objects positioned beneath each ball at the bottom of the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two balls to be in a touching spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to indicate a two balls solution tier
